title: Riyadh airport resumes flights following Houthi attacks

blocks.text: RIYADH — Riyadh’s international airport said flights would resume on Sunday after a two-week closure following strikes from Yemen’s Houthis on the Saudi capital, though the Iran-backed group warned of more to come. The Flight Radar monitoring site showed a plane taking off from Riyadh airport early Sunday, heading to the Saudi city of Jeddah.
